summary: Phase 1 RETEST after Socket.IO routing fix. ALL 33/33 backend tests PASS via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (regression intact). Socket.IO realtime flow (test_socketio_realtime_flow) now PASSES through /api/socket.io path — Engine.IO handshake returns proper JSON ('0{"sid":...}'). Real-time event delivery verified: typing → admin, send_message → new_message ack with status=delivered and recipient receives it, POST /chats/{id}/read → other party gets messages_read event and DB flips to status='read'. Invalid-token connection still rejected. Two-browser Playwright E2E PASSED: (1) admin login → /admin, (2) employee login → /chat, (3) employee opens chat with admin from /directory using dir-chat-btn-{id}, (4) employee typing makes admin see 'typing…' in chat header within ~300ms, (5) emp send → message appears live on admin without reload, (6) admin's open chat triggers read receipt to emp, (7) image upload (PNG via chat-file-input) renders inline image bubble on BOTH sides via /api/files/{id}, (8) logout-btn clears localStorage token and redirects to /login.

minor.issue: Endpoint accepts no body while /reject and /suspend require AdminUserAction body — inconsistency only.

issues: Recharts logs cosmetic 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warning during first render — chart still draws correctly.

action_items: (Optional) Make /admin/users/{id}/approve accept AdminUserAction body for consistency with reject/suspend.
(Optional, perf) Replace in-memory ONLINE presence map with Redis pub/sub for multi-replica deployments.
(Optional) Suppress harmless ws-upgrade-aborted warning in SocketContext — current polling fallback works fine.
critical_code_review_comments: Socket.IO mount path now correctly aligns with k8s ingress (/api/* → backend). Engine.IO + WebSocket upgrade both reach backend now.
SocketContext re-maps backend event names (new_message/message_status/messages_read) to friendly listener keys (message/status/read) for consumers — clean abstraction.
server.py is ~640 lines, on the edge — consider splitting into routers/{auth,admin,chats,files,socketio_handlers}.py post Phase 1.
Default JWT_SECRET fallback 'change-me' should fail-fast in startup if env missing for production.
auth.get_current_user_id has no DB existence check; suspended user with valid JWT can still hit /auth/me for 30d until token expires — add status check for sensitive endpoints.

register endpoint uses await db.users.find_one + insert — race possible on concurrent duplicate registrations; unique indexes catch at insert but 400 won't reflect it. Wrap with try/except DuplicateKeyError.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all tested two-browser realtime flows

test_credentials: Super Admin mobile=7209674114 password=admin (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). E2E test employees auto-registered+approved with TEST_ prefix and time-based mobiles.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers multiple TEST_-prefixed users (approved + suspended + rejected variants). Mobiles are time+random so reruns are conflict-free. Admin can prune via Admin > All Users if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 is fully green end-to-end through the public preview URL. Socket.IO is mounted at /api/socket.io on server side and frontend SocketContext uses path '/api/socket.io'. Verified Engine.IO handshake: curl '<URL>/api/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=polling' returns '0{"sid":...}'. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is idempotent (time-based suffixes) — safe to rerun anytime. For next phase test message reactions/edits/delete, group chat, push notifications etc if those are added.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous iteration RCA (Socket.IO HTML response via public URL) is now MITIGATED: Socket.IO mounted at socketio_path='api/socket.io' in /app/backend/server.py and frontend connects with path='/api/socket.io'. Ingress proxies /api/* to backend, so handshake + websocket upgrade both reach the FastAPI process. Verified end-to-end with pytest test_socketio_realtime_flow (PASS) and dual-browser Playwright (PASS).
